content.body:
Delivered in 1939 the He 111 was the first modern level bomber deployed by the Luftwaffe. Its design requirement was to be able to deliver its 2000kg bomb load anywhere in Continental Europe from central Germany, and preferably without the need for fighter escort. While that requirement was realized the day the first example was flown, the range and speed of both the RAFs Spitfire and Hurricane fighters later proved that the He111 could not operate alone.
With 5 defensive gun positions and docile handling due to its massive wing area, the He111 can defend itself if the chips are down, and in cooperative formations with fighter escort the He111 can really do damage with that huge bomb load. Never take a 111 out alone if you want to be really effective.
Team up with other air brigade members with a specific goal and request fighter escort. Bring along a buddy to man the guns and drop the bombs to really increase your odds of hitting the target and getting home. The bombsight is very accurate if used correctly, take the time to use the bombing guides (printed and online manuals) and practice offline until you are proficient. Also, dropping from a formation on the leaders bomb command can be very effective and allow you to drop without detailed use of the sight.
This is especially useful when bombing larger targets like factories.
